visualObservations.scope: Odd row catalogue91–135; Vespuccistraat corner visible foreground

traits.assertion: Pale narrow projecting horizontal fascia continues along shop row; butt divisions/signboards remain subordinate to a common shophead band.
Large glazed shop panes and entry breaks visible under canopy; parked vehicles, pedestrians and goods obscure exact door/portico positions.
traits.confidence: high for assembly presence; low for exact allocation

traits.assertion: Three upper storeys with pale multi-pane window groups; repeated narrower/recessed vertical bays alternate with broader groups. Foreground corner uses projecting wraparound window groups.
Main row has a long shallow/sloped visible upper silhouette and a raised corner end/central block. Do not replace observed silhouette with arbitrary flat caps or a single equipment maximum.
traits.confidence: medium; photograph angle limits roof depth

traits.assertion: No repeated projecting balcony sequence visible on the long principal shop-facing row in this view; returned/neighbor frontage differs.
Foreground freestanding market stall awnings are separate from fixed building canopy; corner bay windows and side returns must not automatically transfer to straight-row generator.

limitations: Historical photograph; no present survival assertion.
No surveyed canopy dimensions or official Pand identities.
Monochrome photograph does not establish material hues.

visualObservations.scope: Even row catalogue68–114 is right-hand street side; left opposite frontage serves context only

traits.assertion: Right-hand shops show projecting fascia and shop signage over display openings; long perspective/tree occlusion prevents tracing all terminations.
Pale vertically arranged window groups contrast with dark masonry; repeated recessed/protruding vertical group changes appear along right row. Opposite side shows differently grouped wide panes.
Street displays, parked cars and trees obscure exact panes and residential entrances; do not use this record alone to allocate doors/porticos.

limitations: Historical photograph; no present survival assertion.
Native source only1064x713 and quality field Preview; small facade details unresolved.
Canopy roof/aperture surface not visible; no glazing-strip admission.

visualObservations.scope: Catalogue94–96–98 etc; close oblique sidewalk view

traits.assertion: Deep projecting canopy has a pale vertical fascia, rounded darker top/front coping and dark gridded underside. A narrow light/open band is visible behind elevated shop signboards; photograph does not establish glass material or aperture dimensions.
traits.confidence: high for visible band/coping; low for glazing interpretation

traits.assertion: Large shop glazing under canopy and separate signs suspended below it; displays obscure some entrances. Elevated sign panels above canopy differ from hanging signs below it.
Canopy fronts continue into distance with visible panel joints; near foreground front changes direction. No measured corner angle or exact Pand seam inferred.

limitations: No material hues from monochrome image.
Open/light band cannot prove a glazed canopy assembly.

visualObservations.scope: Catalogue68–70–72 etc; close view toward side-street junction

traits.assertion: Projecting rounded coping and broad segmented underside/front panels are clear. Adjacent shop canopy fronts have contrasting pale/dark photographic tones rather than a uniform historical paint value.

Broad shop opening plus narrower separate entrance at right are visible behind security grille. Neighbor shop to left has glazed display panes. Entrance allocation cannot transfer wholesale across row.
Street opening visible at right; current canopy crop shows a termination/returned frontage condition rather than an uninterrupted slab across side street.
Wide signboard sits above coping with separate shutter housing/upper dark shophead below canopy.

limitations: Historic1992 condition only; security grille is temporal shop detail.
Canopy upper roof surface not visible.

visualObservations.scope: Even68–92 row; photograph has90-4-2 corner date imprint, catalogue year1990 retained as authority

traits.assertion: Three repeated upper window storeys beneath tall brick upper/parapet masses; stepped projecting/recessed vertical assemblies alternate along row. Front corner and chimney towers differ from repeated central frontage.
Pale grouped mullioned windows vary between wide groups and narrower corner/bay arrangements; do not copy the opposing row layout.

Broad shop glazing is interrupted by pale piers/door breaks; a vertical narrow-pane/transom-like band sits above shop signs in portions of row. Exact material and current survival require current view.
traits.confidence: high for band presence; medium for pane interpretation

traits.assertion: Long shop-sign/fascia line recurs across the row. Foreground extended sloping fabric awning is a distinct shop fixture; do not turn all of its slope/depth into structural canopy geometry.
Brick upper masses/chimneys dominate silhouette; photo does not expose rear roof planes or establish equipment heights.
